ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the primary surface of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a bifurcated 'Y' shape at the central notch, along the entire trailing edge boundary, and at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregularity towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Exhibits a slight concave curve along the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a straight diagonal sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of roughly circular, textured pixel groupings localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Several faint, circular white spots are visible on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions observed: two diagonal marks on the upper-left lobe and multiple short vertical disruptions near the upper-right trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustations (barnacles) at both distal fluke tips, significantly altering the natural geometric profile at those coordinates.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation forms a highly symmetrical, bifurcated branching pattern extending from the peduncle attachment point toward the center of each lobe.
